name: YouTrack
description: Your YouTrack issues on a page of their own: grouped by state, searched as you type, each opened beside the list with its description, pictures and comments, its state, priority, type, assignee and tags changeable there.
settings_description: Works as you, with a permanent token of yours. It writes to YouTrack only when you pick a state, priority, type, assignee or tag in an issue.

settings.label: YouTrack address
settings.description: Its root, without /api. YouTrack Cloud (*.youtrack.cloud, *.myjetbrains.com) works as is; a self-hosted one's host has to be added to network.hosts in the plugin's manifest (see its README).

settings.label: Permanent token
settings.description: YouTrack → Profile → Account Security → New token, scope YouTrack. Kept by Zeron for this plugin alone.

settings.label: Project
settings.description: A project's short name, such as PROJ. Empty: every project.

settings.label: Extra query
settings.description: YouTrack search added to every list.
